problem: Which set is equivalent to $A={x\in R:\operatorname{cos}⁡(4x)=-1}?$
worked_solution:
Notice that the solutions to the equation

$$
\operatorname{cos}⁡(4x)=-1
$$

 are given by

$$
\begin{aligned}4x & =\pi +2n\pi  \\ x & =\frac{\pi }{4}+\frac{n\pi }{2}\end{aligned}
$$

where $n\in Z.$ 

Substituting different values of $n,$ we see that the solutions are

$$
x=\pm \frac{\pi }{4},\,\pm \frac{3\pi }{4},\,\pm \frac{5\pi }{4},\,…
$$

Therefore, our set $A$ is equivalent to 

$$
A={\pm \frac{\pi }{4},\,\pm \frac{3\pi }{4},\,\pm \frac{5\pi }{4},\,…}.
$$
